all_case_endpoint: Only complete requests with every candidate scored receive recovery credit. Retain failed, partial, unsupported and unstarted requests and all out-of-window labels.
control: One constant-zero score for every requested candidate; deterministic genomic-point tie break and optimistic/mid/pessimistic positive ranks; uninformative ranking control, no biological predictor claim.
final_collection_gate: Separate immutable A admission receipt binding eight successful CI jobs, reviewed collector identity and B protocol acknowledgement before execution; no retry/repacking after outcomes.
forbidden_claims: precision or false discovery from unlabelled sites
whole-genome sensitivity inferred from conditional sampled-window recall

metric_settings.matching: one-to-one maximum-cardinality within tolerance, per query
metric_settings.tie_rule: score, then genomic point ascending, then local index ascending

scope: Frozen analysis identities and settings before native predictions or outcome joins; separate collection admission required.
secondary_endpoint: Successful-position diagnostics are separate and never replace the all-case endpoint.

uncertainty_settings.interval: percentile: sorted defined values v, h = (n - 1) * q, v[floor(h)] + (h - floor(h)) * (v[floor(h) + 1] - v[floor(h)])
uncertainty_settings.resampling: groups sorted by ID; each draw is random.Random(seed).choices(range(G), k=G) in sequence, shared by every endpoint and denominator
uncertainty_settings.statistic: sum of matched / sum of denominator over drawn groups
uncertainty_settings.undefined_resample: zero summed denominator; counted, never set to 0
